bead.title: Pin fjord and bootstrap the embedded Kafka surface
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The embedded fjord surface cannot be exercised until pqueue-server names fjord as a real dependency and boots it from typed config behind the existing composition root seam.
ROOT CAUSE: The current repo has pqueue-server config and startup wiring, but no fjord dependency pin or embedded Kafka bootstrap path.
PROPOSED FIX: Add fjord as a git-pinned dependency with no path deps, thread the embedder config through pqueue-server startup, and allocate fjord state into its own storage namespace without changing the queue commit path.
NON-SCOPE: Kafka record ordering, offset semantics, ACL enforcement, and consumer-group ownership are handled by sibling beads.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestFjordDependencyIsGitPinnedAndNoPathDeps` proves fjord is pinned from git and not from a path dependency.
2. `TestPqueueServerBootsEmbeddedFjordFromConfig` proves pqueue-server can construct the embedded fjord surface from config.
3. `go test ./... -run 'TestFjordDependencyIsGitPinnedAndNoPathDeps|TestPqueueServerBootsEmbeddedFjordFromConfig'`\n4. `lefthook run pre-commit`\n5. `lefthook run pre-push`
